name: readme
text:
# Demo project

A made-up project for trying portcullis.

## Install

Run `make build`, then `make test`. Do not commit your .env file; it holds local settings.

name: dockerfile
text:
FROM golang:1.27 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/app ./cmd/app
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static
COPY --from=build /out/app /app
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
